label: FAB Group
description: A speed-dial: one trigger FABButton that opens up to five action items. Stack lists them vertically with labels; the three fan layouts open them on an arc of icon-only FABs, centered, left or right of the trigger.

props.name: layout
props.description: Vertical and labelled, or an icon-only arc centered, left or right of the trigger.

props.name: items
props.type: { icon: ReactNode; label: string; onSelect?: () => void }[]
props.description: Up to five actions; label is shown in stack, else it is the aria-label.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger toggles the menu.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: The closed trigger icon (Figma IconLeadingIcon). Defaults to Phosphor's plus.

props.name: triggerOpenIcon
props.description: The open trigger icon. Defaults to Phosphor's x.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The trigger's accessible name (Figma Label, "Create") — it is icon-only.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger and every item.

usage: Use where several floating actions share one entry point (create → photo, edit, share…). The trigger's icon swaps plus → close when open. Give every icon-only item an accessible name.
accessibility: role="group" with an aria-label. The trigger is a native <button> with aria-expanded; every item needs an accessible name (its label prop) since fan items are icon-only.
